site.sitedescription: Pond is a circular, shallow sinkhole (3.5 ha) in a karst up-land of gentle relief. Hillcrests are 10-15 m above the surface of the basin. Most of the surrounding area is in cropland or pasture, with scattered woodlots of Quercus and Carya spp. Fagus grandifolia, Fraxinus americana, Acer saccharum, and other mesic species occur in valley bottoms. The basin itself at the time of coring was vegetated by emergent Nuphar, graminoids (Cyperaceae and Poaceae), and scattered individuals of C. occidentalis and A. saccharum.
